description: This file defines the SystemCheckController class within the OrangeHRM installer upgrader namespace. The class extends an abstract installer Vue controller and sets up a component for the 'system-check-screen' during the pre-render phase, also updating application state to indicate the current screen.

classes.name: SystemCheckController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling the 'system check' step during upgrade, initializes a Vue component and updates the application state.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component for rendering the system check screen and updates application state to reflect the current screen.
